title: Tonikaku Kawaii: Joshikou-hen
jp_title: TONIKAWA: Over The Moon For You - High School Days
description: Nasa, at the request of his former junior high school teacher, Ms. Yanagi, finds himself entrusted with teaching a programming class at a high school. But here’s the catch—it’s an all-girls’ school. Surrounded by the limitless energy of teenage girls, Nasa tries to maintain his composure, but deep down, he can’t help feeling nervous. A capricious boyfriend, secret admiration for someone, and a multitude of romantic dilemmas that can’t be solved by programming, Nasa wonders if he can crack the equation of love! (Source: MAL News)
